local_review.finding_body: The generated suite violated test-contract musts: pooled-connection tests directly obtained InvocationHandlers and manually invoked Object.getClass instead of reaching reflection through ordinary library behavior; TimestampUtilsTest forced java.version to Java 8 and required --add-opens to exercise a path unavailable on the resolved JDK; generated test metadata contained unstable lambda class names as typeReached conditions; and several explicit database timeouts were below 10 seconds while Docker process waits were unbounded. These contradicted FS-test-contract.2.1, FS-test-contract.2.8, FS-test-contract.1.7, FS-test-contract.1.6, and the condition-cheating rule in FS-contribution-contract.4.
local_review.finding_title: Generated tests used artificial dynamic-access paths and invalid execution bounds
local_review.fix_note: Removed the direct InvocationHandler calls and their stale Object.getClass metadata, removed the Java-8 simulation test, JVM override, and stale TimeZone metadata, removed unstable lambda typeReached entries, raised explicit I/O timeouts to at least 10 seconds, bounded Docker command waits, and regenerated normalized test-only metadata and statistics through Forge finalization.
local_review.review_comment: The final tree is scoped to org.postgresql:postgresql:42.7.13, uses only reachability-metadata.json, preserves meaningful public-API native execution, and passes the recorded index gate. The repaired stats pass the ordered fixes-* coverage gate: overall 49/51 (96.078%) to 47/53 (88.679%) and reflection 45/47 (95.745%) to 44/49 (89.796%) each drop by less than 20 percentage points; resources 4/4 to 3/4 passes the small-report rule because covered calls drop by only one. The exact Forge finalizer then completed current-defaults, future-defaults-all, and GraalVM 25 test lanes plus metadata validation, style checks, generated-test validity, and statistics, and a second complete run made no publishable change.
